articleHeadline: Measles in Philippines: Vaccination campaign launched to improve coverage
articleSummary: In 2025, Western Visayas reported 444 cases of measles and rubella, with 22 confirmed measles cases and 6 rubella cases, highlighting significant immunization gaps below the 95% herd immunity target. The median age of affected individuals was 17 years, with no reported deaths or clusters. Notably, Capiz experienced its first measles cases in three years, while Iloilo City and province saw an increase in cases. The Department of Health (DOH-6) attributes the outbreak to vaccine hesitancy and low public awareness about the safety and availability of free MR vaccines at health centers. To address this, a Phase 3 Measles-Rubella Supplementary Immunization Activity (MR-SIA) is scheduled from August 10 to 28, 2026, aiming to vaccinate 408,114 children aged 6 to 59 months, regardless of their vaccination history. The campaign targets specific regional populations to enhance vaccination coverage and curb the transmission of the disease.
